detailed_descriptions.en: Find it, pick it up, snap it into place Open a bag of parts and spread the colorful bricks across your workbench. Follow the instructions, find the pieces you need, and snap them into place. With each satisfying click, your model takes shape. Enjoy the simple pleasure of building, one brick at a time. On your own or with friends Build at your own pace, or settle in for a chat with friends. Up to 4 players can share a workbench online and build one model together. Someone puts up the walls while someone else adds the windows, each helping out a piece at a time. Chat, listen to your favorite music, and watch a little creation come together—a keepsake of the time you've shared. Hands-on, down to the smallest detail Put on the stickers, open the doors, and move the curtains. Discover rooms and tiny decorations you couldn't see while building. Once the last piece is in place, take a leisurely look around your finished model. The little space you've made is full of details worth a closer look. What little world will you build today? Cozy country cottages, spaceships, pirate ships, little retro game consoles, and the tightly packed buildings of Kowloon Walled City. Build your way through a variety of themes, piece by piece. As you finish models in the same theme, a short story unfolds. Grow your collection and discover the warm little stories within. Discover 11 themes, 33 models, and 6,000+ bricks to put together, one by one. Enjoy making something with your own hands, from opening the bag to placing the last sticker. Unwind with a solo build, or finish a model together in online co-op for up to 4 players. Fill your collection with new models and discover heartwarming stories along the way.
